card.name: Dose-level words before dose or level
card.fires_on: Level words such as higher, low, high, median or usual that sit just before a dose, concentration or level term. Mostly in text about vitamin D, methotrexate, steroids and calcium.

modes.label: High/low before dose
modes.description: The words high, low or higher directly before dose, doses or -dose.
modes.example: 20% increase after<< low>> dose MTX, higher dose MTX

modes.label: Median or usual before a level
modes.description: Words like median or usual that introduce a measured level or concentration.

card.plain: It marks words that say how big a dose or level is, just before the dose or level is named.
